observation.command:
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; cd /workspace
echo "=== mise version ==="; mise --version
echo "=== node/npm ==="; mise exec -- node --version; mise exec -- npm --version
echo "=== node_modules ==="; ls node_modules | wc -l; test -d node_modules && echo "node_modules present"
echo "=== git hooks (per-repo) ==="; ls .git/hooks/pre-commit .git/hooks/commit-msg
echo "=== build artifacts ==="; ls dist/index.html && echo "dist present"
echo "=== wrapper snapshot ==="; test -d .app-wrapper/wrapper && echo present
echo "=== quick checks ==="
mise run type-check >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "type-check OK" || echo "type-check FAIL"
mise run lint >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "lint OK" || echo "lint FAIL"
mise run format >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "format OK" || echo "format FAIL"
mise run stylelint >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "stylelint OK" || echo "stylelint FAIL"
